title: Add ZBOSS NCP protocol dissector
description:
Zigbee stack ZBOSS by DSR has serial protocol for Network Co-Processor configuration (NCP).
This is an implementation of dissector for this protocol.
The idea is to display both serial NCP commands and 802.15.4 traffic in the same pcap file.
Sample pcapng file attached.[dump.pcap](/uploads/d840118c0284b70ad57452b09bcbe2f3/dump.pcap)

I think you misunderstood how FT_BOOLEAN works in a header field. Setting the FIELDDISPLAY to '1' throughout is probably not what you want. The use of this field is overloaded to state how wide the field is where the bit is found, so that the presentation is of the bit can be put into context. The mask for the actual bit is given in the aptly named BITMASK field. For example a set bit with FIELDDISPLAY of 8 and BITMASK of 0x01 would be displayed as ".......1", and the next set bit (with BITMASK 0x02) would show up as "......1.".

What you can't do, in this overloaded field, is use SEP_DOT for instance, since that makes no sense for FT_BOOLEAN. The only exception is the use of BASE_NONE, if there's no bit in the packet data related to the tree item added, usually for generated items.
I think, that I got it.

commits_data.title: Added dissector for ZBOSS NCP protocol with link type 292.
commits_data.message:
Added dissector for ZBOSS NCP protocol with link type 292.

Added linktype 292 that was recently added to libpcap.
Added NCP dissector based on this linktype.

Removed static qualifier for varible `zboss_page_names` in packet-ieee802154.c
to make it accessible from the NCP dissector.
